4517.title: [skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m150 bug fixes
4517.author: mattleibow
4517.body:
[skia-sync] Merge upstream chrome/m150 bug fixes (#4517)

Companion: mono/skia#290
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/0aa2d542e8...80c7b8fdf0

Release-line bug-fix sync for release/4.150.x. Advance the externals/skia
submodule from 0aa2d542e8 to the release/4.150.x tip 80c7b8fdf0, which
merges mono/skia#290 (upstream chrome/m150). The milestone is unchanged
(stays m150) and there is no version bump.

The submodule bump picks up two upstream Ganesh correctness cherry-picks
and nothing else:

  * 587c5b0f5a  [M150] [ganesh] prevent stale readbacks (Bug: b/521491024)
    SurfaceContext::readPixels() now propagates a failed flush so a
    readback can no longer return stale texture data.
  * 37d3aa648b  [Ganesh] If a resolve task fails to execute unwind the
    dirty tracking (Bug: 517973093, Fixed: 536237281)
    Restores a proxy's MSAA/mipmap dirty state when a resolve task ends
    without executing, avoiding inconsistent dirty-rect tracking after a
    dropped flush.

Scope is entirely Ganesh GPU internals plus GPU tests (6 files upstream,
+279/-11). There are no C API changes (include/c, src/c), no DEPS
changes, and no exported-symbol changes, so P/Invoke bindings are not
regenerated and the ABI is unchanged. The only files in this repo are
the submodule pointer and the matching cgmanifest.json commitHash;
SK_C_INCREMENT stays 0 and VERSIONS.txt is untouched.

Build & test (Linux x64): native externals build, SkiaSharp.csproj
build, and SkiaSharp.Tests.Console all pass (5584 passed / 172 skipped /
0 failed). Remaining platforms are exercised by PR CI.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
